T001.summary: Added the versioned agent-orchestration policy, task-files/v1 authoring template, and supplemental protocol. The policy fixes local protocol/template refs and SHA-256 values, role/runtime and eleven-step/interview matrix, capability and classification gates, and approved i-have-adhd 0.3.0 bytes without copying upstream content. The protocol keeps canonical skill invocation distinct from delivered context and limits Files/Result and phase-ordered deferred semantics to an adopted candidate contract, with Result required only for dispatchable writes and leader-reserved evidence deferred without one.
T001.evidence: This run: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B focused stdlib policy/template/protocol validation passed: strict JSON and duplicate-key rejection; local references and SHA-256 values; policy roles, eleven-step/interview matrix, capabilities, classification, task contract and approved i-have-adhd bytes; dispatchable-Result and leader-reserved deferred rules; and protocol invocation/phase-order/PARTITION-NO-WORKERS semantics. No baseline was run; git status --ignored was checked for bytecode artifacts.
